ns2:course.label: Labor and the European Union
ns2:course.description: Addresses the formation of European Union (EU) labor policy; the role of trade unions in EU member nations; worker immigration in the EU; diversity issues in the EU labor market and a comparative analysis of industrial relations in Europe. Same as EURO 410 and SOC 410. Prerequisite: Consent of the instructor.
